typography.name: --font-mono
typography.raw: "Geist Mono Variable", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

components.name: Badge
components.usage: Label a status, category, or count inline next to a title or row. Never use it as a button.
antipatterns: Wrapping a Badge in an onClick handler instead of using Button.
Overriding the background with a raw hex value rather than a variant.

components.name: Button
components.usage: Primary interaction control. Use variant for emphasis and size for scale; use asChild to render a link that looks like a button.
antipatterns: Adding a `primary` boolean prop instead of variant="default".
Styling a div with buttonVariants and a click handler instead of using Button.

components.name: Card
components.usage: Surface container for grouped content. Compose with CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent and CardFooter.
antipatterns: Hand-rolling a bordered div with p-6 instead of Card.
Putting the title in CardContent instead of CardTitle.

components.name: CardContent
components.usage: Main body region of a Card.
antipatterns: Adding your own outer padding that fights the card rhythm.

components.name: CardDescription
components.usage: Secondary supporting line under a CardTitle.
antipatterns: Using it for body content — use CardContent.

components.name: CardFooter
components.usage: Action row at the bottom of a Card.
antipatterns: Placing actions loose after the Card element.

components.name: CardHeader
components.usage: Top region of a Card; holds CardTitle and CardDescription.

components.name: CardTitle
components.usage: Card heading. Renders semantic heading text, not a paragraph.
antipatterns: Applying custom font sizes with raw px values.

components.name: Input
components.usage: Single-line text field. Always pair with a visible label wired via htmlFor/id.
antipatterns: Using placeholder text as the only label.
Setting inline height/border styles instead of relying on tokens.

components.name: Textarea
components.usage: Multi-line text field for notes and long copy.

constraints: Use theme tokens for color, spacing, radius, shadow and typography — never raw hex, rgb or px values for anything the token set covers.
Import components from the design-system barrel; do not fork or duplicate a component to change its look.
Express visual variation through the `variant` and `size` props; never add one-off boolean styling props.
Build on semantic elements (button, a, label) and keep every interactive state keyboard reachable with a visible focus ring.
Typography is Geist Sans / Geist Mono via --font-sans and --font-mono. Never introduce another family.
Dark mode is class-based (`.dark`); read colors through semantic tokens so both faces resolve automatically.
patterns: Compose Card + CardHeader/CardTitle/CardDescription/CardContent/CardFooter for any grouped content surface instead of custom bordered divs.
Merge incoming className with cn() and forward refs so consumers can extend a component without wrapping it.
Use the `glass` / `glass-dark` utilities for frosted panels over brand grounds rather than hand-mixed rgba backgrounds.
Pair form controls with an explicit <label htmlFor> and use Textarea for multi-line copy.
Reach for --shadow-* elevation tokens (navy-tinted) instead of Tailwind's neutral shadow scale.
